voiceScript: One leaked password can unlock accounts on websites that were never breached. Credential Stuffing means criminals take usernames and passwords stolen from one breach and automatically try them on other websites. Picture this: a leaked shopping-site password suddenly opens the victim's email account. Here is why that matters: password reuse can turn one company's breach into several stolen accounts. Use a different password for every account. Turn on multi-factor authentication and replace exposed passwords. You do not need to be an expert.
